title: Arithmetic Tokenizer
description:
Implement a `tokenize` function that converts an arithmetic expression string into an array of tokens. Each token has a `type` (`'number'`, `'plus'`, `'minus'`, `'star'`, `'slash'`, `'lparen'`, `'rparen'`) and a `value` (string).

**Example:**
```js
tokenize('3 + 42 * (2 - 1)')
// [{type:'number',value:'3'},{type:'plus',value:'+'},{type:'number',value:'42'},{type:'star',value:'*'},
//  {type:'lparen',value:'('},{type:'number',value:'2'},{type:'minus',value:'-'},{type:'number',value:'1'},{type:'rparen',value:')'}]
```
ai_context: Common mistake: not accumulating multi-digit numbers — treating each digit as a separate token. Also forgetting to skip whitespace.
